title: Ending E Timeline
heading: GPOM second half · the ending · scene E: the bus
intro: Scene E of the ending, round 1 (Kai's notes, 23 Oct): a woman on a bus is watching this film; Maddie's "Mind how you go." comes out of her phone; she looks up at her own high street; a red bus drives away. The AI's last line is not recorded yet: its slot is a silent hold. Play it, click any beat, clip, line or sound, and leave a note in its yellow slip. Notes save as you type. Tell Claude when you're done.

beats.title: The bus
beats.see: Hard cut on sound: a woman on the top deck at night, watching her phone. On it, gleaming Maddie among the empty chairs (the last frame of D, composited). Tinny, through the phone: "Mind how you go."

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Mind how you go. (from her phone)

beats.title: She looks up
beats.see: Over her shoulder: the empty chairs on her phone, her own high street through the wet window (the chip shop, the pharmacy, the closed bank). She looks up from one to the other.

beats.title: The bus drives away
beats.see: Tight on the lit red bus (140%), a 1.5 s hold, then an eased pull-back to the whole wet high street as the bus pulls away. The AI, unfiltered and close, for the first time (its line owed). Fade to black.

lines.name: The AI (opening to his own voice, for the first time)
lines.text: I made it. Don't make me come back twice.

beats.title: Black
beats.see: Black. The last low piano note decays. No logo, no "We are BadCode".

flags: E01 (Kai ld9-1/le1-0): Maddie's "Mind how you go." is said whole through the woman's phone, 0.3 s after the hard cut (it is no longer split across the cut): D ends on the silence after "Boss...", and E opens on the rain, the bus and her small voice from the phone.

E01/E02 (E round 3, Kai: the overlaid screen looked "a bit grainy... quite obviously just overlaid"): the phone screen is now painted by Flow in-camera (stills E01p-b / E02p-b, made with D's last frame as the reference: glowing, with glare and its light on her hands), animated as E01p-t1 / E02p-t1. Checked at 4 fps: the screen holds its picture in every frame, never white, no ghost. The ffmpeg screen composite (phone_screen.py) is no longer used.
E01: a slow push 100 -> 110% toward the phone after a 1.5 s hold (eased, in post), so the screen reads before the cut.

E02 (review round 1): the closed bank is lettered in post (bank_sign.py, exact, tracked to the plate's 1.5 px breathing by phase correlation, softened behind the wet glass): a plain fictional name, DOWNLAND BANK, on the blank fascia, and a printed "THIS BRANCH HAS NOW CLOSED" notice on the card in its middle window. The name is my call (fictional, regional, ties to the downs): Kai to rule.
E02 runs 6 s (scene.json), not clips.json's 7: she has turned to the bank by 3.5 s and 2.5 s of her holding still is enough (my call). Camera locked, no post move: her turn is the movement.

E03 regrade: the chained take (E03r4-t1 + E03xr4-t1) cools and flattens as it runs (channel means up to R+1 G+5 B+6 of 255 by ~10 s, partly because the rain thickens). A ramped per-channel grade pulls every frame 60% of the way back to its first 2 s; the 8 s join itself has no step.

E03 (Kai reel at4010, ending round 2): the red bus on an EMPTY road. The plate was edited again (E03r4b-c: every car and headlight removed; the hooded pair on the right went with them), re-animated (E03r4-t1, 10 s) and extended (E03xr4-t1, 8 s) from its last frame with a far oncoming vehicle painted out first (E03r4-last-clean-a), so nothing drives towards the bus. Omni pans the camera slowly right in both clips (asked for locked).

E03 (Kai at353): a RED double-decker. The still was edited (E03r3-b: E03b-r1-b with the bus made plain pillar-box red, no roundel, no route number, no adverts, nothing written on it), re-animated (E03r3-t1, 10 s) and extended from its last frame (E03xr3-t2, 8 s: locked, the bus recedes further, the two walkers turn and walk away). Joined here as before: the tail's first frame dropped, a 0.3 s dissolve over the join (it steps 2.7 against a 0.8 in-clip median, an exposure jump). The closed bank is the same plate, so bank_sign_e03.py letters it as before (DOWNLAND BANK and the closure sheet, tracked). Omni drew small unreadable fascia lettering on the far shops: left.

E round 6 (Kai, 4 Nov): the cut to Parliament is ON "I made it." (9.1 s into the bus shot; at529: the bank sign skews and the bus jumps at the end of E03). "Now the real work starts." is cut; after a 2.4 s pause, "Don't make me come back twice.", slower, the punchline. Both sentences from Kai's pick of Suno revision I, take 0ecce5dc. The last shot is the new, real-looking Houses of Parliament (Kai at699; his pick e-b: the embankment railing and lamppost, a light drizzle), E04r4-t1, Omni Flash 10 s, camera locked, a slow push in post.
Voice: "I made it." keeps a 40% trace of Maddie's speaker filter; "Don't make me come back twice." is his own voice, full range, close. The coda ducks 6 dB under both.
E04: 1.5 s of black (scene.json planned 3 s): the coda's last low note sounds just after the picture has gone and is left to decay to about -42 dB, then faded (my call).

Music: e-coda comes in on the cut to E02 (7.0 s), not on her look-up 2 s later, so that with one edit (its opening phrase to 9.05 s, then straight to the phrase at 23.45 s, a 0.1 s crossfade on a low point; the first rise is cut) its held-chord pocket falls under the line and its last low note falls on black. The edit is measured on the level envelope, not heard: Kai to rule by ear.

Sound (review round 1): the synthesised rain, bus and street are replaced by recorded CC0 beds (Freesound HQ previews, E/sfx/CREDITS.md): a bus interior engine and rain on a window with wet traffic outside under E01-E02 (one continuous bed each, so nothing switches at the cut; the engine eases down and duller before E02, pulled in at the stop), then rainy-night traffic and a bus departing from a stop under E03. Each was checked for speech with whisper (VAD): none. Not heard by ear in this run: Kai to rule on the beds.
Sound: the cut lands on sound (rain, the bus, the phone), no music under E01, as music.md plans.
Colour: mean RGB measured on both sides of every cut; the biggest steps are E01p-t1 -> E02p-t1 (31/255) (a change of place or light, not a drift inside a shot).
Nobody has listened to this cut: every level, duck and sound placement is measured, not heard.

delivery-qc on preview.mp4: 5 ok, 3 warn, 1 fail. FAIL TAGGED LIMITED RANGE, CONTENT IS FULL — whites will clip. Fix with: -vf 'scale=in_range=full:out_range=limited' -pix_fmt yuv420p -color | warn 1 near-black stretch(es) — check the head and tail are intentional | warn 1 frozen stretch(es) — a stuck frame or a still held too long | warn off the -14 LUFS target — platforms normalise, so this mostly costs you dynamics The range FAIL is x264 quantisation ringing on a few grain pixels per frame: the picture is clamped to 16-235 before the encode (cut3.LEGAL) and the encoder overshoots (scene E: luma 2/247 on isolated pixels; the 10th/90th percentiles stay inside 16-235 on every frame, 16/156); cut 3 A's preview fails the same way. Not a range-tag mismatch. -16 LUFS is the house target for these scenes (the brief), not -14.
